task_objective: Extract shared release-selection logic into plugin_release_utils.py and fix testing-channel semver selection
design_decisions: Extracted normalize_version, parse_semver, version_sort_key, has_exactly_one_zip, get_zip_asset, and select_best_release into plugin_release_utils.py.
Fixed select_best_release to rank purely by version_sort_key so higher semver prereleases (e.g. 2.0.0-beta.1) take precedence over lower stable releases (e.g. 1.0.0) when allow_prerelease=True.
Updated generate_json.py to import and delegate to plugin_release_utils while re-exporting parse_semver for external callers.
